dataset.title: Dataset for H2SAFE - Controlled Gas Releases and Sensor-Response for Indoor Hydrogen Safety
dataset.reuse_terms: The catalog grants use and copying with the full notice retained and requires DOE/NLR/Alliance credit in resulting publications.
dataset.physical_medium: Helium surrogate releases in full-scale indoor laboratory enclosures

before_inspection: download the published archive only after this protocol is committed
record HTTP metadata, byte size and SHA-256 of the archive
retain raw files outside the Git worktree
inspect archive member names and metadata before reading concentration values

eligibility_and_split_plan.source_eligibility: Require timestamped concentration channels, declared release timing and coordinates, sensor coordinates and ventilation state. Reject a test missing any primary field from numerical scoring.
eligibility_and_split_plan.frozen_holdout: Hold out one entire experiment, including all of its sensor channels. Select the holdout from metadata identifiers only before numerical concentrations are read; retain the other eligible experiments for adapter configuration without tuning simulator physics.
primary_endpoints: release-to-first-sensor detection delay at a declared normalized experiment-relative threshold
detector ordering agreement relative to source and ventilation geometry
post-release concentration decay classification when the source metadata declares an end time
metrics: rank correlation for first detection time

runtime_and_claim_boundary.allowed_runtime_use: Evidence and regression validation of an advisory detector-response/ventilation adapter only; no automatic recalibration of site virtual detector amplitude or safety PLC setpoints.
prohibited_inferences: hydrogen concentration equivalence from helium volume fraction
fire, explosion, thermal-radiation or separation-distance validation
runtime_and_claim_boundary.negative_result_policy: Any malformed archive, failed eligibility criterion, failed holdout metric or contradiction remains recorded. A pass can support only the stated indoor helium-surrogate detector-response evidence scope.
